title: Someone Kept Doing Laundry at the Closed Laundromat #shorts #horror
description: The laundromat under my flat closed years ago. So why does a dryer start spinning every night at 2 AM? #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: The laundromat closed years ago. The dryers didn't stop.

lines.text: I live above a laundromat that closed five years ago.
Every night at two, I hear a dryer start spinning.
Last night, I finally went down to look.
The windows were dusty. One machine glowed inside.
Through the glass door, I watched it tumble.
It wasn't clothes. It was my coat. My scarf.
The ones hanging in my hallway upstairs.
The dryer stopped. The little door swung open.
A wet handprint pressed against the glass. From inside.
When I got home, my hallway hooks were empty.
And something was knocking from inside my closet.
